have.text: notes-ai already does embeddings search over your notes and calls OpenAI.
motion-kit shows you can keep a test suite going: 31 test files.

moves.title: Add an eval harness and citations to notes-ai
moves.body: You turn notes-ai from a demo into a product you can defend: a question set, an eval that scores the answers, citations in every answer, and prompts that are versioned and compared.

phases.title: Write the question set
tasks: Collect questions your notes can answer and the answer each should contain
Mark which note each answer must cite
Commit the set as a fixture next to the prompts
phases.deliverable: A fixture of questions with expected answers and citations

phases.title: Score every answer
tasks: Write a runner that asks each question and compares the answer with the expected one
Report a score per question and a total in the terminal
Run it in GitHub Actions on every push
phases.deliverable: A passing eval run in CI with a score table

phases.title: Add citations and fix chunking
tasks: Return the note and line each answer rests on
Replace the chunking the TODO names with chunks that keep a heading with its text
Re-run the eval and keep the chunking that scores best
phases.deliverable: Answers that cite their notes, and an eval that shows the change

phases.title: Version the prompts
tasks: Keep each prompt change as a new file next to the old one
Run the eval against both and record the scores in the README
Write up what changed and why
phases.deliverable: A README section with prompt versions and their eval scores

have.text: Recipe Genie already calls OpenAI through a Supabase Edge Function and returns structured JSON.
Its UI shows rotating loading text and a retry-less error toast today.

moves.title: Give Recipe Genie streaming, a retry and a thumbs-down
moves.body: You replace the loading text and the dead-end toast with the patterns the role expects: streamed output, a retry that keeps the input, and a rating that is stored.

phases.title: Stream the recipe
tasks: Switch the Edge Function to a streamed response
Render the recipe as it arrives, with a stop button
phases.deliverable: A recipe that appears line by line

phases.title: Retry and rate
tasks: Add a retry that keeps the pantry list and shows what changed
Add a thumbs-up and a thumbs-down stored in a Supabase table
Show the last rating next to the recipe
phases.deliverable: Ratings in a table you can query

have.text: The Recipe Genie prompt takes dietary filters.

moves.title: Compare three prompt versions for Recipe Genie
moves.body: You write two more versions of the prompt, run the same pantry inputs through all of them, and keep notes on what each version got wrong.

phases.title: Write the versions
tasks: Copy the prompt into a versioned file
Write a stricter and a shorter version
phases.deliverable: Three prompt files in the repository

phases.title: Run and compare
tasks: Run the same pantry inputs through each version
Note what each version got wrong in a table in the README
phases.deliverable: A README table comparing the versions
